title: Chargers’ misery hits ironic 26-year low that’ll have Jim Harbaugh, Mike McDaniel on hot seat

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Chargers’ misery hits ironic 26-year low that’ll have Jim Harbaugh, Mike McDaniel on hot seat
sources.description: The Chargers fall to 0-7 for the first time since Jim Harbaugh was their quarterback in 2000, extending a brutal 27-drive touchdown drought.
